name: terminal-bridge
description: Opens, renames, and closes VS Code terminal tabs via a local HTTP API

terminalBridge.pipelineStateDir.description: Directory (relative to each workspace folder) that /api/status appends pipeline-state.json into.

terminalBridge.agentId.description: Identity this window's main agent announces to the presence registry (/announce, /api/bridges). Falls back to the workspace name, then the first folder's name, when unset.

terminalBridge.stages.description: Ordered stages a consumer can put a terminal in with `bridgectl stage <name> <key>`. Shown in the Terminal Bridge panel as the row icon, description and hover step list. The bridge ships none; an unlisted key is still shown, as text. The headless bridge reads the same list from ~/.vscode-terminal-bridge/config.json.

terminal.description: A final stage (e.g. merged): shown as done, not current work.

terminalBridge.hostsCommand.description: A command that prints every host's terminals as one JSON document (see the README, "All hosts view"). When set, an All hosts view appears in the Terminal Bridge container and runs it every 30 s while the view is visible. Empty: no view. Machine-scoped: a Remote-SSH window reads the remote host's value, not the laptop's.
